title: Virtual Care Service Standards: Hours, Response Times, Staffing and Equipment
content:
Each Virtual Care visit type carries its own settings for when the service is available, whether same-day access is offered, how quickly an e-visit gets a clinician reply, how long an on-demand request may wait in the queue, how long an unsubmitted e-visit questionnaire is kept, the longest scheduled session, who staffs the encounter, the device the patient needs and whether an interpreter can be added.

## Definitions

- **Operating hours** — when the service is available. The value is one of three: business hours, extended hours (7:00 to 22:00 daily) or always.
- **Same-day access** — whether same-day access is offered (yes or no).
- **E-visit reply time** — the number of business hours (8:00 to 17:00, Monday to Friday) within which an e-visit gets a clinician reply. A value of 0 means the standard does not apply to the visit type.
- **Queue maximum wait** — the longest wait, in minutes, in the on-demand queue before the request is released with a full refund. A value of 0 means the visit type has no queue.
- **Questionnaire expiry** — the number of hours an unsubmitted e-visit questionnaire is kept before it expires. A value of 0 means the standard does not apply to the visit type.
- **Longest scheduled session** — the longest session scheduled for the encounter type, in minutes.
- **Staffed by** — who staffs the encounter: a physician or advanced practice clinician, a licensed therapist or psychiatrist, or a specialist physician.
- **Device needed** — the device the patient needs: the MyLinden portal only, a phone only, or a video-capable device.
- **Interpreter** — whether a video or phone interpreter can be added (yes or no).

## Availability and timing

| Visit type | Operating hours | Same-day access | E-visit reply time | Queue maximum wait | Questionnaire expiry | Longest scheduled session |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | Business hours | Yes | 8 business hours | 0 (no queue) | 72 hours | 0 minutes |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | Business hours | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no queue) | 0 (not applicable) | 20 minutes |
| Primary Care Video Visit | Extended hours | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no queue) | 0 (not applicable) | 20 minutes |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | Business hours | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no queue) | 0 (not applicable) | 50 minutes |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | Business hours | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no queue) | 0 (not applicable) | 30 minutes |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | Always | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | 90 minutes | 0 (not applicable) | 15 minutes |

## Staffing and equipment

| Visit type | Staffed by | Device needed | Interpreter can be added |
|---|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | Physician or advanced practice clinician | MyLinden portal only | No |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | Physician or advanced practice clinician | Phone only | Yes |
| Primary Care Video Visit | Physician or advanced practice clinician | Video-capable device | Yes |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | Licensed therapist or psychiatrist | Video-capable device | Yes |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | Specialist physician | Video-capable device | Yes |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | Physician or advanced practice clinician | Video-capable device | Yes |

## Notes on the tables

- Only the Portal E-Visit carries an e-visit reply time and a questionnaire expiry; only On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care carries a queue.
- Same-day access is not offered for the Behavioral Health Video Visit or the Specialty Video Follow-Up; it is offered for the other four visit types.
- The Portal E-Visit is the one visit type for which an interpreter cannot be added.
- The Primary Care Video Visit is the one visit type available during extended hours, and On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care is the one visit type available always; the remaining four are available during business hours.
